Name: Zadok, Sealer of the Covenant
Summary: Zadok was among the chiefs who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day, listed with Meshezabeel and Jaddua. NOTE ON IDENTITY: the text does not say whether this Zadok is Zadok the scribe or any other Zadok, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 10:21 sealer and does not merge him with any other Zadok.
LifeLesson: A sealed covenant is a promise put in writing.
